title: Hey Nico, you didn't vibe code your data room but stole it from Papermark
summary: A Twitter post accusing a developer named Nico of stealing a data room implementation from Papermark instead of creating it through 'vibe coding' - highlighting an alleged intellectual property theft incident in the AI-assisted coding space.
problem_solved: This is not a problem-solving content but rather an accusation of code/IP theft within the startup community.
why_valuable: Serves as a cautionary tale about intellectual property concerns in the era of AI-assisted development and vibe coding.
